nodes.title: SG-8.4.1 Single-writer history status in ContributionSheet
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) loads history with listMine in a useEffect (L44-L66) and swallows failures silently. There is no history status. Desired behavior: one 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' type, written only by the history effect, a reload counter in that effect's deps, and a guard against updates after the effect is cancelled. Expected result: the history list shows loading, ready or error deterministically and never updates after close, round change or unmount. Why: robust, visible history loading (SG-8.4).

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet opens with a round id, When listMine is pending, Then a loading message is visible
- Given listMine rejects, When the sheet is open, Then an error message and a Retry button are visible
- Given Retry is clicked, When listMine is called again, Then status returns to loading and then ready on success
- Given the sheet closes or roundId changes before listMine settles, When the promise settles, Then no state is updated


## Scope
- In scope: HistoryStatus type, status state, reload counter and cancel guard in ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: Empty-history state
- Out of scope: Changes to api/client.ts
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Preserve: Submit, validation, quota and feedback behavior
- Preserve: Merge of history with entries sent while loading
- Preserve: Dialog focus behavior


## Technical constraints
- Only the history effect may write the history status
- Use the existing listMine API from ../api/client


## Definition of done
- All three requirements delivered with Act and Verify units green


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · History status is one 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' value with a loading message
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet has no history status and hides load failures. Desired behavior: a HistoryStatus type 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' held in one useState, written only by the history effect, rendering a loading message while pending and an error message on failure. Expected result: players see what the history is doing. Why: visible loading.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given listMine is pending, When the sheet is open, Then 'Loading your suggestions…' is shown
- Given listMine resolves, When status becomes ready, Then the loading message is gone and entries are listed
- Given listMine rejects, When status becomes error, Then 'Could not load your suggestions' is shown in role=alert


## Scope
- In scope: HistoryStatus type and render of loading/error messages
- Out of scope: Retry
- Out of scope: Empty state
- Preserve: Existing submit feedback alerts


## Technical constraints
- Single useState<HistoryStatus>; no second boolean flag


## Definition of done
- Status type and messages implemented


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A reload counter in the history effect powers Retry
nodes.body:
Context: no way to reload history after failure. Desired behavior: a reloadKey counter in the history effect deps; the error state shows a Retry button that increments it, and the effect alone sets status back to loading. Expected result: one click retries the load. Why: recoverable failures.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given status is error, When Retry is clicked, Then listMine is called a second time
- Given the retry resolves, When the effect settles, Then status is ready and Retry is gone
- Given status is not error, When rendered, Then no Retry button exists


## Scope
- In scope: reloadKey state, effect dependency, Retry button
- Out of scope: Automatic retry or backoff
- Preserve: Single-writer rule: the button never sets history status directly


## Technical constraints
- Retry handler only calls setReloadKey


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Retry works via the reload counter


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · History effect never updates state after it is cancelled
nodes.body:
Context: the effect has a cancelled flag checked only in .then; .catch has no guard. Desired behavior: every state write (status and entries) in both .then and .catch is skipped once the cleanup ran. Expected result: no updates after close, roundId change or unmount. Why: avoid stale or leaked updates.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet closes while listMine is pending, When it later rejects, Then no error message is rendered on reopen before the new load settles
- Given roundId changes while the first request is pending, When the first resolves, Then its entries are not added
- Given the component unmounts, When listMine settles, Then no React state-update warning is logged


## Scope
- In scope: cancelled checks in then and catch
- Out of scope: AbortController or client changes
- Preserve: Merge of history with in-flight sent entries


## Technical constraints
- Guard by local cancelled flag set in effect cleanup


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Both promise branches guarded


## Clarifying questions
- None
